area.source: GOB 36 uses hostile selector 3 with a 2 m radius centred on its chosen enemy.
area.runtime: AbilityTargets.LandAround resolves the selected centre, and AbilityHostile limits secondary effects to published, eligible targets within the same-floor radius.
area.test: StarterCoderSplashBatchMode and PR452 stock captured one hit on the selected QAEnemy and one on QAFriend at 1.79 m, while QAFar at 2.65 m took none. The paired Static Blast control only hit its selected enemy. AreaDisruptionTests checks pending and published secondary views. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/452. PR490 ad5075b9 also verified that friendly QAOther is refused as the direct target and is spared as a secondary inside the splash radius. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/490
